description: This PHP file contains a unit test class 'AccessFlowStateMachineServiceTest' for testing the 'AccessFlowStateMachineService' class within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup routines and multiple test cases verifying functionalities like DAO access, allowed actions retrieval, workflow state transitions, record management, and role management, using mock objects and test data.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for 'AccessFlowStateMachineService' covering various functionalities such as DAO access, state management, action checks, and role handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates the service, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineDao.

methods.name: testSetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Tests setting a custom DAO and retrieving it correctly.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActions
methods.description: Checks retrieval of allowed actions for specific workflow, state, and role, including null case.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Tests fetching allowed workflow items for given parameters.

methods.name: testGetNextState
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the next workflow state based on current parameters, including handling null results.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Checks fetching states that are actionable given certain actions, workflow, and role.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests saving a WorkflowStateMachine record via the service.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a workflow record with success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsService
methods.description: Tests retrieval of multiple workflow state machine records for a specific workflow type.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedService
methods.description: Checks if the service correctly responds to an action permission query.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Verifies fetching a specific workflow item based on state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Tests deleting workflow records for a user role.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Verifies handling renaming of user roles in workflow records.
